title: StudioJob
description: Body of GET /v1/studio/jobs/{job_id}. The phone polls it until status is completed (then fetches the result and the video) or failed.

status.description: uploading until POST /start; editing while Claude works.

stage.description: A short line about what Claude is doing now, for the phone's progress text.

eta_s.description: Estimated seconds until the edit finishes, from the clips, their size, the output length and the model; the bridge refines it with its past runs. Null unless status is editing; 0 once the estimate has run out (still working).

error.description: Null unless status is failed; then code is agent_failed, agent_timeout or internal.
